description: Source code for the Zephyr driver for the STMicroelectronics LPS22HH pressure and temperature sensor, including initialization, data fetching, conversion, and configuration functions.

methods.name: lps22hh_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the output data rate (ODR) for the sensor.

methods.name: lps22hh_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches raw pressure and temperature data from the sensor.

methods.name: lps22hh_press_convert
methods.description: Converts raw pressure data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: lps22hh_temp_convert
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: lps22hh_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the pressure or temperature value.

methods.name: lps22hh_odr_set
methods.description: Sets the sensor's output data rate based on frequency.

methods.name: lps22hh_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as sampling frequency.

methods.name: lps22hh_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the sensor chip, verifies device ID, configures interface and default ODR.

methods.name: lps22hh_init
methods.description: Performs overall sensor initialization, including chip init and trigger setup.
